mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS downward trend occurs without positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or return distribution not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% occurs without negative 5-day returns in more than 30% of cases, or negative return not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate rises and employment growth slows (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% monthly), it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition (UNRATE>4.5% AND PAYEMS growth<0.5%) occurs without negative 20-day returns in more than 35% of cases, or interaction effect not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.3% in 3 months), reduced liquidity and higher risk-free rates cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rising > 0.3% in 3 months occurs without negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or negative return not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth > 0.5% monthly for 3 months occurs without positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or return distribution not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1800 thousand units, it signals housing market contraction and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1800 occurs without negative 5-day returns in more than 30% of cases, or negative return not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 4.5%, it signals policy response increasing equity volatility, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition (CPIAUCSL>2.5% AND FEDFUNDS<4.5%) occurs without negative 20-day returns in more than 35% of cases, or interaction effect not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in employment (PAYEMS growth < 0.3% monthly) signals weak labor market conditions reducing corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition (UNRATE>5.0% AND PAYEMS growth<0.3%) occurs without negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or negative return not statistically significant (p>0.05).
